# laravelforge_site_load_balancing (Resource)

Manages the load-balancing node set of a Laravel Forge balancer site (singleton per site).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `balancer_method` (String) Load-balancing method. One of `round_robin`, `least_conn`, `ip_hash`.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server that owns the balancer site.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the balancer site.

### Optional

- `balancer_keepalive_max_connections` (Number) Maximum number of keepalive connections (0-256).
